note: What a server sends to say how many dragon buffs a side holds. The header carries zero.

bits.name: order
bits.note: Set for side 100, clear for side 200.

fields.name: counter
fields.note: Which count it sets. A client takes only 0, and drops the message otherwise.

fields.name: count
fields.note: How many buffs the side holds. Both sides start at -1, which hides the counts; once either is 0 or more, a client shows both, a negative one as 0.
